claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Alaproclate is a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor with no reported cytotoxic activity; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive rather than killing cells.

raw.cytotoxic_mechanism: Alaproclate is a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor with no reported cytotoxic activity; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive rather than killing cells.
